{{Top|leg}}
The '''randoos bush''' was a type of [[Bush/Legends|bush]] that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]].<ref name="Tethan">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]''</ref>

{{Flora-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|But you know the old saying: A Tethan in the hand is worth four clone troopers in a randoos bush!|[[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], to a [[Unidentified Tethan youngling|Tethan youngling]] in one adventure path in ''The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure''|<ref name="Tethan" />}}
The randoos bush appeared in [[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure|''Tethan Battle Adventure'']], a [[2010]] entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny]]'' series of choose-your-own-adventure books.<ref name="Tethan" />
